paper_title: Process-Aid Solid Engineering Triggers Delicately Modulation of Y-Series Non-Fullerene Acceptor for Efficient Organic Solar Cells
source_file: /home/wzfeng/MySearch/PhotoRag/MD/Advanced Materials - 2022 - Song - Process‐Aid Solid Engineering Triggers Delicately Modulation of Y‐Series Non‐Fullerene/auto/Advanced Materials - 2022 - Song - Process‐Aid Solid Engineering Triggers Delicately Modulation of Y‐Series Non‐Fullerene.md

knowledge_points.content: 1,3-dibromo-5-chlorobenzene (DBCl) is utilized as an asymmetric, volatile process-aid solid (PAS) that can be completely sublimated from the photoactive layer during thermal annealing at 75 °C for 5 minutes.
knowledge_points.evidence: DBCl can be completely volatilized at this temperature... there is no signal of Cl or Br in the blend film in the XPS profiles measured from neat PM6:Y6 and PM6:Y6:DBCl annealing film.

knowledge_points.content: The PM6:L8-BO organic solar cell treated with DBCl achieved a champion power conversion efficiency (PCE) of 18.5% with a fill factor (FF) of 80.2%.
knowledge_points.evidence: Consequently, an impressive fill factor of 80.2% with maximum power conversion efficiency (PCE) of 18.5% in the PAS-treated device is achieved.

knowledge_points.content: DBCl molecules demonstrate a stronger miscibility with Y-series acceptors like Y6 (Flory-Huggins parameter χ = 0.64 K) compared to the polymer donor PM6 (χ = 1.36 K).
knowledge_points.evidence: the χ parameter for PM6:DBCl is 1.36 K, which is much higher than the value for Y6:DBCl blend (0.64 K)... DBCl is more miscible with Y6 than that of PM6.

knowledge_points.content: Density functional theory (DFT) calculations indicate that coupling DBCl with the Y6 molecule increases the dipole moment from 1.01 Debye in neat Y6 to 1.93 Debye in the Y6:DBCl dimer.
knowledge_points.evidence: After coupling the DBCl on top of Y6, the diploe moment remarkably increases to 1.93 Debye, with an improvement of 91.1% in comparison with that of neat Y6.

knowledge_points.content: GIWAXS characterization shows that DBCl treatment enhances the out-of-plane π-π stacking of Y6, resulting in a stacking distance of 3.67 Å and an increased coherence length of 24.36 Å.
knowledge_points.evidence: the Y6:DBCl mixed film possesses a π-π stacking distance of 3.67 ± 0.17 Å accompanying with the enhanced coherence length of 24.36 Å according to the Scheer equation.

knowledge_points.content: In the PM6:Y6 system, PAS treatment significantly improves the balance of charge transport, increasing the electron mobility from 1.70 × 10⁻⁵ to 1.67 × 10⁻⁴ cm² V⁻¹ s⁻¹ and the μe/μh ratio from 0.076 to 0.42.
knowledge_points.evidence: the hole (μh) and electron (μe) mobility are increased from 2.24 × 10⁻⁴ and 1.70 × 10⁻⁵ to 3.99 × 10⁻⁴ cm² V⁻¹ s⁻¹ and 1.67 × 10⁻⁴ cm² V⁻¹ s⁻¹ respectively, together with a μe/μh ratio increased from 0.076 to 0.42.

knowledge_points.content: PAS treatment suppresses trap-assisted recombination in organic solar cells, as evidenced by the reduction of the light-intensity dependence slope (Voc vs ln(I)) from 1.31 kT/q to 1.14 kT/q.
knowledge_points.evidence: slopes of 1.31 and 1.14 kT/q for control and PAS-treated device, respectively, showing that PAS strategy can efficiently eliminate the trap-assisted recombination.

knowledge_points.content: Film-depth-dependent light absorption spectroscopy (FLAS) reveals that PAS treatment induces a vertical gradient where Y6 is concentrated at the top surface and PM6 is enriched at the bottom near the substrate.
knowledge_points.evidence: the Y6/PM6 ratio gradually improves in the photoactive film and Y6 is concentrated at the top region, whereas PM6 is enriched in the bottom part (near substrate).

knowledge_points.content: PAS-treated PM6:L8-BO devices demonstrate exceptional thickness tolerance, maintaining a PCE of 17.0% at a photoactive layer thickness of 300 nm.
knowledge_points.evidence: a record PCE of 17.0% together with FF of 74.1% is obtained when the thickness of the photoactive layer rises to over 300 nm which represents the highest efficiencies for the thick-film OSC so far.

knowledge_points.content: Devices processed with PAS engineering exhibit improved storage stability, retaining over 80% of their initial PCE after aging in a nitrogen atmosphere, compared to less than 60% for control devices.
knowledge_points.evidence: the PAS based devices maintain the highest normalized PCE (retaining > 80% of the initial PCE) compared with the control devices, which retain < 60% of their initial PCEs within the same time frame.

knowledge_points.content: Sensitive EQE (s-EQE) analysis shows a reduction in Urbach energy (Eu) from 31.6 meV to 30.2 meV upon PAS treatment, indicating a decrease in energetic disorder within the blend.
knowledge_points.evidence: the Eu values based on control and PAS devices are 31.6 and 30.2 meV, respectively... disclosing that enhanced crystallinity of PM6:Y6 blend would decrease the energetic disorder.

knowledge_points.content: FTIR spectroscopy confirms a strong interaction between DBCl and the BTP core of Y6, evidenced by the shift of stretching vibration peaks from 2932.8 and 2869.0 cm⁻¹ to 2928.3 and 2857.8 cm⁻¹.
knowledge_points.evidence: two peaks shift from 2932.8 to 2928.3 nm⁻¹ , 2869.0 to 2857.8 nm⁻¹ , respectively, confirming a strong interaction between DBCl and BTP core unit.
